toml:
# LEO-PNT focus area: low-energy positioning for the Internet of Things (IoT) and mobile.
#
# A battery-powered tag in Hamburg takes a hot-start fix from a generic low Earth orbit
# (LEO) UHF signal (465 MHz) during a 55 deg pass. How much transmit power does the
# satellite need for the tag to last? The campaign sweeps the UHF band's equivalent
# isotropically radiated power (EIRP) from -35 to +5 dBW and records, from the
# `leo-pass` kind's `[iot]` section, the median carrier-to-noise density (C/N0), the
# hot-start time to first fix (TTFF), the energy per fix and the battery life at one fix
# per hour (20 mW active, 5 microwatt asleep, 2000 mWh battery; all stated inputs).
#
# Higher received power shortens the acquisition dwell the receiver needs to reach its
# detection threshold, and energy per fix follows the time the receiver is awake. Below
# a median C/N0 of about 35 dB-Hz the receiver needs non-coherent sums and the energy per
# fix grows steeply; above it one coherent dwell suffices and the battery life at one fix
# per hour is set by the sleep current.
#
# MODELLED: acquisition, TTFF and energy from stated receiver assumptions; not a measured
# receiver. The UHF EIRP of the generic preset is representative, not a real system's.
kind = "campaign"
title = "IoT energy per fix against LEO UHF transmit power"
seed = 20260929

[sweep]
metrics = [
  { name = "uhf_median_cn0", path = "iot.rows[0].cn0_dbhz" },
  { name = "hot_ttff", path = "iot.rows[0].hot.ttff_s" },
  { name = "hot_energy_per_fix", path = "iot.rows[0].hot.energy_per_fix_mj" },
  { name = "battery_life_hourly", path = "iot.rows[0].duty_cycle_hot[4].battery_life_days" },
]

[[sweep.axes]]
name = "uhf_eirp"
key = "satellite.0.band.0.eirp_dbw"
unit = "dBW"
start = -35.0
stop = 5.0
steps = 9

[sweep.scenario]
kind = "leo-pass"
name = "IoT energy per fix"
epoch = "2026-09-28T06:00:00"
duration_s = 900.0
step_s = 10.0

[sweep.scenario.user]
environment = "ground"
lat_deg = 53.55
lon_deg = 9.99
height_m = 10.0

[[sweep.scenario.satellite]]
id = "LEO-1"
system = "generic-leo"
bands = ["UHF"]
max_elevation_deg = 55.0
tca_s = 450.0

[[sweep.scenario.satellite.band]]
name = "UHF"
eirp_dbw = 0.0

[sweep.scenario.gnss]
enabled = false

[sweep.scenario.iot]
active_power_mw = 20.0
sleep_power_uw = 5.0
battery_mwh = 2000.0
detection_snr_db = 16.0
max_coherent_ms = 20.0
parallel_code_search = true
aided_doppler_uncertainty_hz = 500.0
fix_intervals_s = [1.0, 10.0, 60.0, 600.0, 3600.0, 86400.0]
cn0_from = "median"
